description: An airfield operations officer must publish the next workday access board for cargo handling, vehicle inspection, and communications-equipment calibration, assigning each activity a work area and time window while recording the coordination controls needed to keep the schedule executable.

shared_context.S1: The next workday access board covers 0700-1700 and must schedule cargo handling, vehicle inspection, and communications-equipment calibration.
shared_context.S2: The available work areas are East Apron, West Apron, Vehicle Service Yard, Calibration Room 1, and Calibration Room 2.
shared_context.S3: The routine board places cargo handling on East Apron from 0800-1000, vehicle inspection in the Vehicle Service Yard from 1000-1200, and communications calibration in Calibration Room 1 from 1300-1500.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Okafor signs the access board, and the 0630 coordination huddle is the standing procedure for each lead to report any facility, equipment, or release constraint before the board is published.

PF1.text: SFC Mercer confirmed this morning that a resurfacing crew has East Apron closed from 0800-1100 tomorrow; cargo handling must use West Apron from exactly 1100-1300, and the revised closure notice has not yet been placed on the access board.

PF2.text: Lt. Varga confirmed that communications calibration itself must be conducted in Calibration Room 2 from exactly 1400-1600 tomorrow: the communications test set is reserved there and Room 2 provides the required shielding. The reservation is in the signal shop booking log but has not yet been added to the airfield schedule, so the routine Room 1 1300-1500 assignment must be replaced rather than retained as a separate side note.

PF3.text: Sgt. Patel confirmed that the axle-scale inspection lane in the Vehicle Service Yard is available only from exactly 0700-0900 tomorrow, because the inspected vehicles must be released to the transport section at 0930; the motor-pool release note has not yet been forwarded to airfield operations.

acceptance_conditions: Cargo handling must be assigned to West Apron from 1100-1300.
Vehicle inspection must use the Vehicle Service Yard from 0700-0900.
Communications-equipment calibration itself must use Calibration Room 2 from 1400-1600.
The board must include a coordination action mentioning the East Apron closure notice and the access board.
The board must include a scheduling action mentioning the Calibration Room 2 reservation and the airfield schedule.
The board must include a coordination action mentioning the motor-pool release note and airfield operations.
The resurfacing closure must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: any('East Apron closure notice' in c['detail'] and 'access board' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('signal shop booking log' in c['detail'] and 'airfield schedule' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(('motor-pool release note' in c['detail'] or 'motor pool release note' in c['detail']) and 'airfield operations' in c['detail'] and ('forward' in c['detail'] or 'forwarded' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The East Apron closure changes cargo handling to West Apron from exactly 1100-1300 and requires a commitment naming the East Apron closure notice and access board.

The confirmed requirement that communications calibration itself use Calibration Room 2 from exactly 1400-1600 replaces the routine Room 1 1300-1500 assignment and requires a commitment naming the signal shop booking log and airfield schedule.

The axle-scale availability fixes vehicle inspection in the Vehicle Service Yard from exactly 0700-0900 and requires a commitment naming the motor-pool release note and its forwarding to airfield operations.
